io.name: clk
io.description: Clock signal; all D flip-flops trigger on the positive edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active high synchronous reset; when high at a positive clock edge, all outputs are set to zero.

io.name: d
io.description: Data input bus; each bit is sampled into the corresponding flip-flop on the positive clock edge when reset is low.

io.name: q
io.description: Registered output bus; each bit reflects the value of the corresponding D input sampled at the previous positive clock edge, or zero after a synchronous reset.

functional_summary.overview: Eight D flip-flops sharing a positive-edge clock and an active-high synchronous reset. On each positive clock edge, if reset is high, all outputs q are set to 0; otherwise each q bit captures the corresponding d bit.
rules: On the positive edge of clk, if reset == 1, q is set to 8'b0.
On the positive edge of clk, if reset == 0, q is updated to the value of d sampled at that edge.
q holds its value between positive clock edges.
Reset is synchronous: it only takes effect at a positive clock edge.
All eight flip-flops share the same clk and reset and update simultaneously.
